summary: 引擎无关的分支对话：用 Ink、Yarn Spinner 或小型 JSON 图运行器实现台词、选项、条件、变量和本地化编号。 Builds engine-neutral branching dialogue with Ink, Yarn Spinner or a small JSON graph runner: lines, choices, conditions, variables and localization IDs. Use for NPC conversations, dialogue trees, barks, .ink or .yarn files, or dialogue that dead-ends. Not for visual-novel backlog and skip (`visual-novel`), quests (`rpg`) or text box widgets (`godot-ui-control`, `game-ui-ux`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill dialogue-systems，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
